acts: AIFC Rules No. FR0007 of 2017 (Fees Rules)

en.title: FEES 1.2.5(a), 1.2.6(a) and Schedule 7 refer to each other; no amount is set
en.summary: FEES 1.2.5(a) and 1.2.6(a) charge "the application fees specified in Schedule 7", and Schedule 7 says that the Chief Executive Officer "may determine the amount of fee specified in 1.2.5 (a) and 1.2.6.(a)". No amount appears in the Rules themselves, while section 9(7) of the Framework Regulations speaks of a fee "prescribed in the Rules".
en.correction: Please publish the applicable CEO fee determination under Schedule 7, with its authority and effective date.
